issues.description: Version-level manifest contains 'cc: clang' and 'cxx: clang++' fields in the build section, but rpm2cpio is a shell script tool that requires no C/C++ compilation. The notes.md correctly states '编译器: 无需编译器（shell script）', yet the manifest metadata still declares clang/clang++ as compilers. This is misleading metadata implying compilation occurred when none did.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the 'cc' and 'cxx' fields from the build section, or set them to empty/null values (e.g., 'cc: null' / 'cxx: null') to accurately reflect that no compiler is used for this shell script package.

issues.description: The docstring does not follow the exact format specified in code_style rule 1: '"""Conan recipe — {name} {version} ({build_system})"""'. The current docstring is a multi-line string starting with 'Conan recipe for rpm2cpio — a shell script tool...' without the version number or build system in the standard parenthesized format.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider updating the docstring to more closely match the standard format, e.g.: '"""Conan recipe — rpm2cpio 1.4-r3 (makefile)"""' or include the version and build system in the first line.

issues.description: The test_package test only runs 'rpm2cpio dummy1 dummy2' which triggers usage output and exits 0. While this satisfies R34 (it executes the binary, not an empty shell test), the test does not verify actual RPM-to-cpio conversion functionality. A more comprehensive test would create a minimal/dummy RPM file and verify the cpio output.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding a test case that creates a small dummy RPM file (or uses a pre-built test fixture) and verifies that rpm2cpio produces valid cpio output, testing the actual conversion path rather than just the usage message.

issues.description: The Makefile created in build() includes an 'install' target with full DESTDIR support, but the package() method does not use 'make install' — it manually copies and renames the script using os.rename and creates symlinks with os.symlink. The install target in the Makefile is effectively dead code.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either invoke 'make install' in package() using self.run() with appropriate DESTDIR/PREFIX, or remove the install target from the Makefile if manual packaging in package() is the intended approach.

issues.description: In the software-level manifest.yaml, the license field 'license: BSD-2-Clause' is not quoted, while other string values in the same file (display, description, homepage, build_date) are properly quoted with double quotes.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add double quotes around the license value for consistency: 'license: "BSD-2-Clause"'.

summary: Audit of rpm2cpio 1.4-r3 Conan recipe (shell script tool, FreeBSD ports source). P0 (deceptive behavior): No issues found. R34 test executes the binary (not an empty shell test). Status 'built' is consistent across all files. SHA256 is a valid 64-char hex string. No precompiled binaries in PR. No #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs. P1 (recipe correctness): No issues found. Version 1.4-r3 follows versioning strategy. Source URL is official FreeBSD ports GitHub mirror. Conan 2.x API used correctly. commands.json present for CLI tool. conandata.yml properly formatted with HTTPS URL and sha256. P2 (code conventions): One issue — version-level manifest has misleading 'cc: clang'/'cxx: clang++' fields for a shell script that requires no compilation. P3 (suggestions): Four minor items — docstring format deviation, minimal test coverage (only verifies binary execution, not actual RPM conversion), unused Makefile install target, and unquoted license field in software manifest. Verdict: PASS (zero P0/P1 issues).
